To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) The performance of applications on coarse-grain re-configurable architectures depends on the way operations are scheduled onto the processing elements.
(1) The network topology traversal strategy and the number of interconnects between processing elements have significant effect on the performance of coarse-grain reconfiguration architectures.

(a) a spiral traversal strategy coupled with a two-neighbor interconnection topology leads to good overall performance for the DSP applications considered; (b) a spiral traversal with a two- neighbor interconnect topology is better than a spiral traversal with an all-neighbor interconnect topology; and (c), a spiral traversal with two-neighbor interconnect is better than a row traversal with a two neighbor topology
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: (a) How does the network topology affect application execution? (b) How do the traversal strategies affect application execution? and (c) How does the interconnect topology affect application execution?
the following issues: (a) the design of a framework for network topology exploration; and (b) the design of network topology traversal strategies and network topologies to be explored.
the exploration and tuning of the interconnect topology of coarse-grain reconfiguration architectures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a spiral traversal of a two neighbor interconnection network topology leads to good results for the DSP benchmarks studied.
the interconnect topology and traversal strategy have a major impact on the performance of the applications.
the network topology is not the most important parameter in the performance of the architecture, but it is a factor that should not be ignored.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the interconnect topology, interconnect delay and the traversal strategy are the key factors to be explored to improve the performance of applications mapped on a mesh-based coarse-grained reconfigurable architecture.
the network topology exploration is an important aspect of the architecture exploration for the mesh-based coarse-grained architectures.
the network topology exploration is a viable approach for improving the performance of applications mapped to coarse-grain re-configurable architectures.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance of a coarse-grain re-configurable architecture can be improved by exploring different network topologies, traversal strategies and communication delays.
the network topology of coarse-grain reconfiguration architectures has significant impact on application performance.
network topology exploration is a promising technique that can be used to improve the performance of coarse-grain re-configurable architectures.
